ci-bot: CI job integrated-tests/shard-7 failed (exit 1). https://ci.redwood/12345/jobs/67890

```
E   AssertionError: expected 1000 ops, got 987
   File "tests/kv/consistency_test.py", line 142, in test_consistency_randomized
     assert result.total_ops == 1000
... (snip)
```

luis: On it, will review in ~30m.

sara: Thanks — please add an entry to flaky-tests.md if we disable anything.
